defs.def: to do sth wrong or illegal 做出（错事）；犯（罪）

ex.s: When Esmeralda is later sentenced to death for a crime she did not commit, Quasimodo rescues her from an angry crowd outside the Notre-Dame Cathedral.
ex.t: 当Esmeralda后来因她没有犯下的罪行被判处死刑时， Quasimodo将她从巴黎圣母院外的愤怒人群中解救出来。

defs.def: to kill yourself deliberately 自杀
to promise sincerely that you will definitely do sth, keep to an agreement or arrangement, etc. 承诺，保证（做某事、遵守协议或遵从安排等）

ex.s: Somewhere around 57,Mike finally ost his weight through a serious (commit) to exercise and diet.
ex.t: 大约在57岁左右，迈克终于通过认真（承诺）锻炼和节食来减轻体重。

defs.def: to give an opinion or make a decision openly so that it is then difficult to change it （公开地）表达意见，作出决定（以致日后难以更改）

ex.s: I decided to commit to completing the applications, and soon I was a part of a growing global team of young people working to protect nature.
ex.t: 我决心完成申请，很快我就成为一个不断壮大的全球年轻人团队的一员，致力于保护自然。

ex.s: All the different hallways and rooms were too much to think about, let alone commit to memory.
ex.t: 所有的走廊和房间各不相同，多到让人难以想象，更别说记在心里。

defs.def: to be completely loyal to one person, organization, etc. or give all your time and effort to your work, an activity, etc. 忠于（某个人、机构等）；全心全意投入（工作、活动等）

ex.s: Even the most engaged and committed audience will eventually get bored.
ex.t: 骑行是最经济、最可持续、最有趣的探索这座城市的方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: Committing themselves to becoming an expert.
Moreover, there are people who choose to step out of their comfort zone and commit themselves to working for the benefit of others.
ex.t: 此外，有些人选择走出自己的舒适区，致力于为他人的利益而努力。

defs.def: to spend money or time on sth/sb 花（钱或时间）
to order sb to be sent to a hospital, prison, etc. （下令）把（某人）送进（医院或监狱等）
to send sb for trial in court 把（某人）送交法庭受审
to learn sth well enough to remember it exactly 把 … 学好记牢
to write sth down 把 … 记（或写）下来

chunks.en: commit to memory / working / exercise / completing / becoming
chunks.cn: 忠于记忆 / 忠于工作 / 忠于锻炼 / 忠于完成 / 忠于成为
